verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developer.calendly.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an "Instructions for AI Agents" section, and doc pages serve clean Markdown by appending .md, with each page header pointing back to the llms.txt index. Agent-oriented guides such as "schedule events with AI agents" and the MCP server docs add to this. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on report of an agent actually consuming the llms.txt/Markdown docs end-to-end, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
